adobe... the creative suite empire. found you on linkedin - sreyansh baranwal, associate developer at adobe. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/sreyansh-baranwal

Yes that's correct
  You there?

associate developer at adobe... building the tools that keep designers and creators around the world from losing their minds. that's some serious impact right there.

The creative tech space, opportunity to learn a lot of great and interesting things

makes sense. creative tech is where the magic happens - you get to build stuff that people actually use to create beautiful things. adobe's got that locked down.

how long you been working total?

I have been working from past 1.8yrs

And at Adobe it's going to be almost 1year next month

1.8 years total, almost a year at adobe... so you had about 8-9 months somewhere else before adobe. solid foundation to build on.

Something related to AI or Backend

ai or backend... smart move. ai's obviously hot right now and backend's always solid. with your adobe experience you've probably seen some interesting ml/ai stuff in action.

I am open for Bangalore and ready to relocate to other cities as well and open for remote work also

done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yess

yooo welcome to the tal family! 🔥

you're officially in the system now. roles that match your vibe will start sliding into your dms when the right ones pop up. ai and backend opportunities with that adobe credibility? you're gonna do just fine.

keep building, keep growing, and when something fire comes up that screams "sreyansh" - you'll be the first to know.

let's get you that next level move! 💪
